# TempLedger

> Intelligent workforce orchestration for businesses running agency workers at scale — verified payroll, live compliance, and complete visibility.

TempLedger gives employers control over third-party labor: bookings, attendance, exceptions, payroll verification and billing are held in one enforced execution chain, so cost and compliance are provable rather than trusted.
